SEMARA

2024

Daily-care mobile app

SEMARA (Senja Emas Rahayu) brings medication reminders, consultation schedules, activities, and nutrition logs into one mobile application. I worked as the backend developer.

Backend engineering

Problem

Bring daily routines and personal-care information together for older adults.

My role

Backend developer for the SEMARA mobile application.

Approach

The app connects onboarding and registration with a dashboard for medication reminders, consultation schedules, activity planning, food logs, and weekly reports.

Result

The team placed 1st in Universitas Sam Ratulangi’s selection for the GEMASTIK XVII Software Development division in 2024.
